sections.heading: 1. Personal Information Protection Policy
paragraphs: Onishi Sangyo Kanko Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "the Company"), which operates Hotel Grand Toya, declares that it complies with laws and other norms related to personal information protection regarding personal information provided by guests, and that it handles such information with the utmost care under its own voluntary systems and rules.

sections.heading: 2. Handling of Personal Information
sections.intro: The Company recognizes "customer privacy" as something important to be respected, and will establish and carry out the following policies.
list: The Company will not collect personal information from guests without their knowledge. We will clearly state the purpose of use in advance when providing services such as improvement of services and product development, and will not use collected personal information for any other purpose.
The Company will appoint a manager responsible for appropriately managing personal information received from guests.
The Company will not provide personal information to third parties without the guest's consent, beyond the scope stipulated by law.

When a guest, as the subject of their own personal information, requests disclosure, correction, or suspension of use of their information, the Company will respond to such requests in accordance with legal procedures.

sections.heading: 3. Collection of Personal Information
sections.intro: The Company collects personal information in the following ways in connection with transactions involving its facilities and products (accommodation, banquets, dining, sale of goods, provision and sale of other ancillary products, provision of services, etc.).
list: Direct collection from the individual: by phone, in writing (including electronic records such as email), business card, verbally, via the internet, etc.
Collection from a party duly authorized by the individual: referrers, applicants, travel agencies (including internet accommodation booking sites), package tour operators, etc.
Collection from published sources: newspapers, the internet, phone directories, lists published by public institutions, publications, and other documents.

sections.heading: 4. Purpose of Use of Personal Information
sections.intro: The Company may use collected personal information for the following purposes.
list: Communication for guidance and confirmation related to transactions with the Company, shipment of materials/products, payment/settlement, and other related matters.
To notify guests via mail, courier, phone, fax, email, or other means for the purpose of improving Company services or providing product information.
For statistical analysis to help improve Company services and develop products.

sections.heading: 5. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
sections.intro: Personal information obtained from guests will not be disclosed to any third party except in the following cases.
list: When the guest has given consent.
When disclosure is required by law.
When necessary to protect a person's life, body, or property, and it is difficult to obtain the guest's consent.
When the Company determines it is necessary to protect the rights, interests, honor, or credit of the Company or other guests.

sections.heading: 6. Disclosure and Correction of Personal Information
paragraphs: The Company will disclose registered information at the request of the individual concerned. If notified that the content is inaccurate, the Company will verify the content and, as needed, add, change, correct, or suspend use of the registered information.

sections.heading: 7. Links on Our Website
paragraphs: To provide guests with useful information and services, our website introduces links to the websites of other companies and organizations. The Company assumes no responsibility whatsoever for the collection or handling of personal information carried out on linked websites. Please use such sites at your own discretion.

sections.heading: 8. Use of "Cookies" for Information Collection on Our Website
paragraphs: Our website collects information and access records using "cookies." This information is used only for statistical processing to operate and improve our website, and for investigating causes such as unauthorized access, and for no other purpose.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: The content of this policy may be changed without notice due to legal amendments, changes in social norms, or other reasons.
